\begin{abstract}

Single-pass (\texttt{1x}) linear activation steering fails in \textbf{MiniMax H3} whenever a static text/vision conditioning matrix $\mathbf{H}_{\text{prelude}} \in \mathbb{R}^{L \times D}$ is re-injected across every block and denoising iteration (\emph{the Frozen-Anchor Prompt Veto}): opposing baseline descriptors inside $\mathbf{H}_{\text{prelude}}$ re-assert themselves across all \texttt{50} joint audio-video blocks and veto rank-1 additions, whereas \texttt{2x} differential velocity guidance doubles compute and requires text rewrites. Studying all four MiniMax H3 checkpoints (\texttt{fl2va}, \texttt{ref2va}, \texttt{P-H3-Image}, and \texttt{MiniMax-H3-Image}; \texttt{5376}-D bidirectional \texttt{TokenRefiner}, \texttt{24 fps} video + \texttt{40 Hz} stereo audio single-stream DiT), we characterize \texttt{1.00x}-NFE creative steering across three coupled mechanisms: \textbf{(1) Affine Prelude Transport} combining prompt-centered rank-$r$ baseline clearing $-\mathbf{P}_{\mathbf{V}_r,\lambda}$ with soft-MaxSim target pushes $\hat{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_d$; \textbf{(2) Causal 4D Depth \& Query Routing} isolating visual/material breakout in \texttt{blocks.20..29} (\texttt{1.52x} mean / \texttt{1.75x} peak DINOv3 face retention over \texttt{blocks.0..49} on \texttt{Stage D} \texttt{90f} \texttt{ref2va} \texttt{paper\_origami}, still below base \texttt{0.399 / 0.657}), a \texttt{10}-block audio emergence lag (\texttt{blocks.31..47}), terminal \texttt{block 49} consolidation, and compiler-safe \texttt{1x Q\_aud -> K\_txt\_base} query slicing (\texttt{Gate 1} \texttt{90f} \texttt{fl2va}: \texttt{1.003x} base latency, \texttt{+0} \texttt{malloc\_graph\_breaks} across \texttt{4} backends, \texttt{YIN} $F_0 = -0.014\text{ st}$ global / $+0.533\text{ st}$ paired median; \texttt{Mode 3} \texttt{ref2va}: \texttt{+1.06 dB}, while Showcase C retains $+0.630\text{ st}$ global / $+0.781\text{ st}$ paired residual \texttt{Q\_aud -> K\_vid} coupling vs. \texttt{2x} $+0.007\text{ st}$); and \textbf{(3) Reduced-Interference Compositional Algebra} addressing up to \texttt{42.4\%} cross-slider erasure and \texttt{50.9\%} shared live-action scaffolding via clamped union spectra ($\lambda_{\max} \le 1.0$), per-slider Retain-Orthogonal Subspaces (\texttt{ROS}, yielding zero first-order peer-target erasure on rank-1 pushes), barrier-aware resolved-mask grouping, and a smooth conditioning-norm knee (\texttt{95.5 -> 98.5}) that eliminated the Phase 4 \texttt{4.0 MP} \texttt{lighthouse} (\texttt{claymation + noir}) diptych (\texttt{highlight\_clip 0.07255 -> 0.00790}, \texttt{3.07s}) and reduced \texttt{box\_office} \texttt{stack3} saturation (\texttt{0.3187 -> 0.1661}). Alongside a pre-consolidation \texttt{52}-stem CPU cross-interference census and \texttt{7}-bank LOPO audit (\texttt{median cos(mu\_d, v\_1d) = 0.9935}), we consolidate the active bank to \texttt{48} verified stems (\texttt{137} \texttt{.safetensors}, \texttt{5} retired including \texttt{stained\_glass\_cathedral} at \texttt{mpc = 0.762} $\to$ \texttt{0/2} \texttt{t=1} screening), document an honest Regime B case study (\texttt{de\_llm\_slop}), falsify unsupervised \texttt{Path 1B} token routing on CPU (\texttt{< 1.1\%} MSE), and settle all three Phase 2 GPU gates (\texttt{1152x768}, \texttt{MiniMaxH3Sol}): verifying live \texttt{1x audio\_only + late\_30\_49} (\texttt{rgb\_mae = 7.461}), \texttt{1x video\_only} (\texttt{0.984x}, \texttt{-0.039 st} paired \texttt{YIN} $F_0$), \texttt{345f} Sol parity, and \texttt{192f} multi-scene evaluation across \texttt{4} verified stems (\texttt{charcoal\_sketch\_animated}, \texttt{x\_ray\_fluoroscope}, \texttt{mercury\_liquid\_chrome}, \texttt{blacklight\_uv\_rave}), while honestly rejecting \texttt{Bus-Scoped V\_r} promotion (\texttt{uv+reverb} exposure blowout), falsifying \texttt{Path 1C} \texttt{ColQwen} \texttt{vision\_tokens} Dual-Lock (\texttt{hsv\_sat = 0.2432} vs. base \texttt{0.2477}), and falsifying \texttt{1x Q\_vid[mask]} splicing against \texttt{2x MiniMaxH3Sol} (\texttt{1.047x-1.090x} portal contrast with layout drift vs. \texttt{1.421x} on \texttt{2x}).

\section{Introduction: Frozen-Anchor Recurrence \& The Three-Pillar Thesis}

\subsection{Autoregressive Self-Steering vs. Prelude Input Injection in MiniMax H3}

In causal autoregressive language models, a weak rank-1 nudge $\mathbf{h}' = \mathbf{h} + s\hat{\mathbf{v}}_{\text{1D}}$ needs only to flip early discrete \emph{pivot tokens}; once sampled, those generated tokens append to the prefix and rewrite the KV cache to self-steer subsequent generation. Non-autoregressive Diffusion Transformers like MiniMax H3 invert this causal topology. H3's \textbf{Prelude} (\texttt{Qwen3-VL-32B} layers \texttt{0..49} + \texttt{condition\_proj} + 2-block bidirectional \texttt{TokenRefiner}) produces $\mathbf{H}_{\text{prelude}} \in \mathbb{R}^{L \times 5376}$ \textbf{once} before step $k = 0$, and the iterative \textbf{Core} (\texttt{50} single-stream \texttt{MiniMaxH3Model} DiT blocks) re-attends the same $\mathbf{H}_{\text{prelude}}$ at every step $k = 0,\dots,K-1$.

When $\mathbf{H}_{\text{prelude}}$ encodes a lighting, palette, material, or acoustic prior contradicting a desired edit, rank-1 mean addition fails at \texttt{1x} NFE (\texttt{0/5} \texttt{noir} stills and \texttt{0/3} \texttt{192f} videos turn monochrome; \texttt{paper\_origami} deletes foreground subjects when forced upward), whereas \texttt{2x} CFG/edit guidance doubles DiT forward passes.

\subsection{Thesis and Tightened Contributions}

This work restricts all empirical claims strictly to verified \textbf{MiniMax H3} video, audio-video, and single-frame DiT pipelines (Table 1 checkpoints) and establishes four bounded contributions:

\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Flagship Mechanistic \& Causal 4D DiT Routing (\S{}5):} Mapping \texttt{blocks.0..49} isolates \texttt{blocks.20..29} as the spatial/material breakout band (yielding \texttt{1.521x} mean / \texttt{1.754x} peak DINOv3 CLS retention vs. \texttt{blocks.0..49} on Stage D \texttt{90f} \texttt{ref2va} \texttt{paper\_origami}, still below unsteered base \texttt{0.399 / 0.657}), a \texttt{10}-block audio lag (\texttt{blocks.31..47}), and \texttt{block 49} sink behavior (\texttt{sol\_attn\_h3.py::SOL\_DENSE\_TAIL}). Promoting compiler-safe hooks (\texttt{steer\_attention\_hooks.py::H3SteerStepWorkspace}) delivers \texttt{1x Q\_aud -> K\_txt\_base} voice protection at \texttt{1.003x} base latency (\texttt{+0} added \texttt{malloc\_graph\_breaks}, Gate 1 \texttt{90f} \texttt{fl2va} \texttt{YIN} $F_0 = -0.014\text{ st}$ global / $+0.533\text{ st}$ paired median; Showcase C $+0.630\text{ st}$ global / $+0.781\text{ st}$ paired residual \texttt{Q\_aud -> K\_vid} shift vs. \texttt{2x} $+0.007\text{ st}$).

We state explicit post-RMS non-inversion ($\gamma \le 1$) and clamped union bounds in \textbf{Theorem 1} and pair \texttt{< 15 ms} Jacobian-lens introspection (\texttt{j\_lens.py::decode\_vector}) with balanced \textbf{Regime A vs. Regime B} diagnostics.

We show that high CPU \texttt{mpc} alone does not guarantee pixel emergence (\texttt{stained\_glass\_cathedral} \texttt{0.762} $\to$ \texttt{0/2} \texttt{t=1}), falsify unsupervised \texttt{Path 1B} token routing on CPU (\texttt{< 1.1\%} LOPO MSE), land \texttt{--scene-prompts} CLI forwarding and \texttt{erasure.mu\_a}/soft \texttt{hold\_alpha} scrubbing, and falsify \texttt{Path 1C} \texttt{ColQwen} \texttt{vision\_tokens} Dual-Lock on GPU (\texttt{hsv\_sat = 0.2432} vs. base \texttt{0.2477}, proving DiT self-attention remains anchored to raw \texttt{reference\_latent} VAE pixels), while leaving explicit \texttt{Path 1A} Ward facet GPU sweeps open.

\section{Related Work (Prior Art \& Attribution)}

To situate this system accurately inside 2020--2026 representation engineering, we explicitly distinguish inherited linear/spectral operators from our empirical joint AV findings:

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Affine Subspace Erasure \& Concept Editing (\texttt{ACE}, \texttt{LEACE}, \texttt{CURE}, \texttt{Safree}, \texttt{IPErase}, \texttt{Linear-AcT}, \texttt{RASteer}):} Iterative nullspace projection (\texttt{INLP}, \texttt{RLACE}) and closed-form oblique projection (\texttt{LEACE}) were unified with activation addition by \textbf{Affine Concept Editing (\texttt{ACE})}, alongside SVD spectral/null-space diffusion erasers (\textbf{\texttt{CURE}}, \textbf{\texttt{Safree}}, \textbf{\texttt{IPErase}}), optimal-transport \textbf{\texttt{Linear-AcT}} (ICLR 2026), and retain-aware \textbf{\texttt{RASteer}} (\texttt{ROS} + \texttt{OAC}, Oct 2026). Rather than re-deriving negative safety unlearning, our Prelude operator adapts affine clearing to \emph{positive, continuous creative conflict resolution} at \texttt{1.00x} NFE using prompt-local centering $\bar{\mathbf{h}}$, $[0,1]$ polarity clamping, and RMS-locked double-dissociation controls.
\item \textbf{Video, Audio, \& Step-Adaptive Steering (\texttt{MUTE}, \texttt{FADE}, \texttt{STAS}, \texttt{TADA!}, \texttt{DATE}, \texttt{Diffusion Steering Lens}):} To our knowledge, prior DiT steering methods evaluate single-modality video or audio backbones separately --- text K/V motion unlearning (\texttt{MUTE}), frame-aware reactivation resistance (\texttt{FADE}), massive activation steering (\texttt{STAS}), dynamic step gating (\texttt{DATE}), or audio-only control (\texttt{TADA!}) --- rather than mapping depth-band specialization and \texttt{1x} query-sliced modal isolation inside a unified single-stream AV DiT.
\item \textbf{Late-Interaction Retrieval \& Static Probes (\texttt{ColBERT}, \texttt{ColQwen}, \texttt{Ward Pooling}, \texttt{Model2Vec}, \texttt{Chain Lens}):} Asymmetric row-softmax aligns unequal-length spans (\texttt{erasure.mu\_d}, \texttt{tau = 0.15}), hierarchical Ward clustering exposes Pole-B facets (\texttt{Path 1A}, CPU-analyzed), and regularized linear inversion (\texttt{j\_lens.py}) provides \texttt{< 15 ms} lexical X-ray visibility into truncated VLM + bidirectional refiner states.
\end{itemize}

\begin{proposition}[Fixed-Prompt Cross-Modal Subspace Bottleneck on \texttt{<Picture 1>} Pairs; formerly Prop 4]
Encoding $N$ paired images $(\text{Pic}_{A,n}, \text{Pic}_{B,n})$ alongside a single constant prompt $P_0$ of $M_0$ tokens concentrates leading right singular directions $\mathbf{V}_r$ onto $P_0$'s lexical variance $\operatorname{span}(\bar{\mathbf{R}}_{P_0} - \mathbf{1}\boldsymbol{\mu}_A^\top)$ whenever cross-attentive perturbations $\|\boldsymbol{\Xi}_{A,n}\|_F$ are small relative to word variance, leaving unseen opposing prompt adjectives in $\ker(\mathbf{V}_r)$. \end{proposition}

\subsection{Lemma 1 (PCRR Empirical Split) \& Theorem 1 (Clamped Compositional EQ)}

\begin{lemma}[Principal Components Ridge Regression Split Diagnostic]
Let $\mathbf{A}_c = \mathbf{U}\boldsymbol{\Sigma}\mathbf{V}^\top$ denote the centered weighted \texttt{diff\_span} matrix with top-$r$ factors $(\mathbf{U}_r, \boldsymbol{\Sigma}_r, \mathbf{V}_r)$. Because $\mathbf{U}_r^\top \mathbf{A}_c = \boldsymbol{\Sigma}_r \mathbf{V}_r^\top$ exactly by orthogonal columns of $\mathbf{U}$, the \textbf{Principal Components Ridge (\texttt{PCRR})} estimator $\mathbf{W}_{\text{PCRR}} = \arg\min_{\operatorname{row}(\mathbf{W}) \subseteq \operatorname{row}(\mathbf{V}_r)} \|\mathbf{D}_c - \mathbf{A}_c \mathbf{W}\|_F^2 + \lambda\|\mathbf{W}\|_F^2$ splits for any $\mathbf{B}_c$ into:
\[
(\mathbf{h} - \boldsymbol{\mu}_A)\mathbf{W}_{\text{PCRR}} \equiv (\mathbf{h} - \boldsymbol{\mu}_A)\mathbf{V}_r^\top \operatorname{diag}\!\left(\frac{\sigma_i}{\sigma_i^2 + \lambda}\right)\mathbf{U}_r^\top \mathbf{B}_c \;-\; (\mathbf{h} - \boldsymbol{\mu}_A)\mathbf{V}_r^\top \operatorname{diag}\!\left(\frac{\sigma_i^2}{\sigma_i^2 + \lambda}\right)\mathbf{V}_r.
\]
\end{lemma}

Verified to \texttt{5.862e-14} (\texttt{bench/verify\_pole\_a\_erasure.py}), Lemma 1 does \emph{not} require ColBERT; its value was falsifying \texttt{M3 = Pole-B transport} by proving \texttt{97\%-99.6\%} (\texttt{ratio 4.2x-10.3x}, \texttt{cos +0.9686..+0.9960}) was the $-\mathbf{P}_{\mathbf{V}_r,\lambda}$ term built solely from \texttt{a\_spans} (\texttt{control\_vectors.py::build\_pole\_a\_erasure}).

\begin{theorem}[Clamped Parametric EQ, Per-Slider \texttt{ROS}, \& Norm-Bounding Properties; \texttt{control\_vectors.py::\_stacked\_erasure\_block\_shift64}]
For $K$ grouped active sliders on identical resolved token rows (\texttt{\_build\_steered\_context}), define per-slider Retain-Orthogonal Subspaces \texttt{ROS} projecting $\mathbf{V}_{r,j}, \mathbf{D}_j$ orthogonal to peer pushes $\{\hat{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_d^{(k)} : k \ne j\}$ (\texttt{control\_vectors.py::orthogonalize\_erasure\_against\_holds}), stack $\mathbf{W}_j = \sqrt{\operatorname{clip}(\min(s_j,1)\mathbf{D}_j^{\text{ROS}}, 0, 1)}\mathbf{V}_{r,j}^{\text{ROS}}$, and eigendecompose with strictly clamped eigenvalues $\mathbf{d}_{\text{union}} = \operatorname{clip}(\sigma^2, 0, 1)$. Then:
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Exact Zero-Point \& Polarity Symmetry:} $\Delta\mathbf{H}(0) = \mathbf{0}$; for $s_j \le 0$, erasure vanishes cleanly (\texttt{clip(s\_j, 0, 1) = 0}).
\item \textbf{Bounded Union Spectrum:} Every union projector eigenvalue satisfies $\lambda_{\max} \le 1.0$, eliminating \texttt{> 1.0} over-subtraction spikes; offline composed payloads cap union rank at \texttt{r\_union <= 16} (\texttt{control\_vectors.py::COMPOSED\_ERASURE\_MAX\_RANK}, spanning two orthogonal rank-8 subspaces cleanly), whereas runtime stacked evaluation (\texttt{control\_vectors.py::\_stacked\_erasure\_block\_shift64}) retains all union modes above \texttt{1e-9} before clamping eigenvalues to $[0, 1]$.
\item \textbf{Post-RMS Non-Inversion Condition:} On single-slider shifts, pre-normalization Pole-A scaling $1 - \operatorname{clip}(s,0,1)\beta_{\text{cap}}g_k \in (0, 1]$ holds post-normalization whenever the outer RMS rescale satisfies $\gamma = |s|\tau_{\text{rms}} / \operatorname{RMS}(\Delta) \le 1$.
\item \textbf{Zero First-Order Peer-Target Erasure (\texttt{ROS}):} For rank-1 peer boosts, per-slider \texttt{ROS} guarantees $\mathbf{V}_{\text{union},-k}\hat{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_d^{(k)} = \mathbf{0}$ identically without an extra runtime pass (orthogonal pushes still share row-norm budget and token bandwidth).
\item \textbf{Smooth RMS Boundedness (\texttt{control\_vectors.py::soft\_cap\_stacked\_rms}):} For any active stacked shift matrix with distinct peer entries, the soft cap leaves row RMS unchanged when $\operatorname{RMS}(\Delta\mathbf{H}) \le \text{knee}$ (\texttt{STACK\_SMOOTH\_KNEE\_NORM = 95.5}) and maps all finite inputs smoothly and monotonically below \texttt{STACK\_SMOOTH\_CEIL\_NORM = 98.5} ($\text{ceil} = 98.5 > \text{knee}$).
\end{enumerate}
\end{theorem}

\subsection{Single-Stream \texttt{blocks.0..49} Specialization \& Mask Boundaries}

Residual-norm profiling across all \texttt{50} single-stream DiT blocks reveals structured modal specialization rather than uniform layer processing:
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{\texttt{blocks.0..19} (Layout \& Reference Identity):} Steered text perturbations in \texttt{0..19} induce \texttt{border\_lap = 69.31} (identical to base \texttt{69.39}) on \texttt{Stage D} \texttt{90f} \texttt{ref2va} \texttt{paper\_origami}, anchoring spatial layout and \texttt{<Picture 1>} facial geometry.

\item \textbf{\texttt{blocks.31..47} (\texttt{10}-Block Audio Lag) \& \texttt{block 49} Sink:} \texttt{40 Hz} audio perturbations emerge \textasciitilde{}10 blocks later than video and consolidate at terminal \texttt{block 49} (\texttt{sol\_attn\_h3.py::SOL\_DENSE\_TAIL}).
\item \textbf{Showcase B Boundary (\texttt{description\_only} + \texttt{ReleaseReferences(0.50)}):} Restricting \texttt{blocks.20..49} strictly to \texttt{description\_only} while holding \texttt{<Picture 1>} leaves identity near baseline (\texttt{felt\_muppet} \texttt{0.392} vs. base \texttt{0.392}) and yields only conservative edits (fluffing hair on \texttt{felt\_muppet}, darkening awnings on \texttt{noir}) unless look/scene spans are targeted.

\subsection{Compiler-Safe Production Runtime: \texttt{1x Q\_aud -> K\_txt\_base} (\texttt{340e8ded})}

To deploy \texttt{block\_band} (\texttt{mid\_late\_20\_49}, \texttt{late\_30\_49}) and single-pass stream isolation (\texttt{streams="video\_only"} / \texttt{"audio\_only"}) without disabling ComfyUI's block-prefetch allocator (\texttt{malloc\_graph}), \texttt{steer\_attention\_hooks.py::H3SteerStepWorkspace} pre-allocates reusable workspace buffers outside the \texttt{50}-block loop under \texttt{pause\_malloc\_graph\_ctx()}, patches \texttt{double\_block} via \texttt{H3SteerBlockPatch}, and computes dual attention outputs across \texttt{4} backends (\texttt{Sol+Sage}, \texttt{Sage}, \texttt{Kitchen}, \texttt{Exact49}):

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Graph-Break Integrity (\texttt{stage2\_verification}):} \textbf{\texttt{+0} added \texttt{malloc\_graph\_breaks} and \texttt{0} rogues} across all \texttt{4} attention backends on \texttt{fl2va} (\texttt{99/0}) and \texttt{ref2va} (\texttt{149/0}).
\item \textbf{Mode 2 \texttt{1x Q\_aud -> K\_txt\_base} (Gate 1 \texttt{90f} \texttt{fl2va} vs. Phase 4 Showcase C):} On Gate 1 (\texttt{de\_llm\_slop +1.15}), Mode 2 runs at \textbf{\texttt{1.003x}} unsteered latency (\texttt{26.91s} vs. \texttt{26.82s}, \texttt{+75.80 MiB}, vs. \texttt{1.73x} slower \texttt{2x} \texttt{49.94s}), holding \texttt{-23.19} vs. \texttt{-23.11 dBFS} with \texttt{YIN} $F_0$ global median $-0.014\text{ st}$ and paired-frame median $+0.533\text{ st}$ (\texttt{voiced\_frac 0.396 -> 0.488}, \texttt{300} splices). In Phase 4 Showcase C (\texttt{90f} \texttt{box\_office}), \texttt{1x Q\_aud -> K\_txt\_base} recovered \texttt{92.7\%} of lost loudness (\texttt{-24.56 -> -22.29 dBFS}) while retaining $+0.630\text{ st}$ global / $+0.781\text{ st}$ paired median \texttt{YIN} $F_0$ shift (vs. \texttt{2x} $+0.007\text{ st}$ global / $-0.007\text{ st}$ paired) from remaining single-stream \texttt{Q\_aud -> K\_vid} coupling, so \texttt{legacy\_2x\_pass} remains available when strict pitch invariance is required.
\item \textbf{Mode 3 Combined \texttt{blocks.20..49} + \texttt{1x Q\_aud} (\texttt{ref2va}):} Recovers \textbf{\texttt{+1.06 dB}} audio loudness over Mode 1 (\texttt{-21.29} vs. \texttt{-22.35 dBFS}, \texttt{+236.21 MiB}, \texttt{180} block swaps) while darkening shop awnings and keeping \texttt{<Picture 1>} face/lip-sync intact (\texttt{0.0501}).
\item \textbf{Phase 2 GPU 4D Resolution (\texttt{192f} Stream/Band Routing \& \texttt{90f} \texttt{Q\_vid[mask]} Gate, \texttt{MiniMaxH3Sol}):} (1) At \texttt{192f} on \texttt{prompt\_bank/t2va\_stairwell\_dialogue.txt}, \texttt{reverb\_192f\_audonly\_late30} (\texttt{streams="audio\_only"}, \texttt{block\_band="late\_30\_49"}, \texttt{auto\_1x\_kv}) ran in \texttt{75.25s} (\texttt{0.967x} base \texttt{77.81s}), preserving frames within \texttt{rgb\_mae = 7.461} (\texttt{sat = 0.3115} vs. \texttt{0.3050}) while shifting audio spectral centroid (\texttt{2505.2 -> 2687.3 Hz}, \texttt{-23.49 dBFS}, paired \texttt{YIN} $F_0 = +0.163\text{ st}$), alongside \texttt{charcoal\_192f\_vidonly\_1x} (\texttt{76.55s} vs. \texttt{77.83s} \texttt{both}, paired \texttt{YIN} $F_0 = -0.039\text{ st}$ vs. \texttt{both} $+0.763\text{ st}$); and (2) Gate 2C (\texttt{90f}, \texttt{t2va\_restaurant\_kitchen.txt}, \texttt{charcoal\_sketch\_animated 1.35}) empirically falsified \texttt{1x Q\_vid[mask]} splicing against \texttt{2x MiniMaxH3Sol} (\texttt{temporal\_pass = false}, \texttt{portal\_pass = false}; \S{}6.5).

\section{Empirical Evaluation}

\subsection{Provenance-Corrected Foundation Baselines (Zero New \texttt{1D} GPU Runs)}

All pre-Phase-2 foundational ablations adhere strictly to disk provenance (retiring v4 omissions and misattributions without spending new GPU cycles on \texttt{1D} comparisons):
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Corrected v4 Table 4 (\texttt{noir} + \texttt{paper\_origami}):} Soft-MaxSim \texttt{mu\_d} rescues edge-case \texttt{noir} convergence (\texttt{3/3} vs. \texttt{v1d\_erase} \texttt{1/3}), whereas \texttt{paper\_origami} (\texttt{cos = 0.9976}) matches identically across both (\texttt{0.550/0.412/0.511} vs. \texttt{0.500/0.414/0.506}, \texttt{3/3} character retention) --- showing $-\mathbf{P}_{\mathbf{V}_r,\lambda}$ carries the structural load while \texttt{mu\_d} resolves length asymmetry when \texttt{cos(mu\_d, v\_1d) < 0.980}.
\item \textbf{Corrected v4 Table 10 (\texttt{gate2b2} \texttt{192f} AV + \texttt{ref2va}):} \texttt{fl2va\_\_noir\_\_S1\_own\_Vr} hits \texttt{0.0791, 0.1398, 0.0776} saturation across 3 seeds (\texttt{8}-bit H.264 dark-scene chroma noise explains \texttt{> 0.06} vs. PNG stills), alongside omitted sibling \texttt{ref2va\_\_noir\_\_S1\_own\_Vr} (\texttt{0.3271, 0.2955, 0.2383}) illustrating Dual-Lock retention.
\item \textbf{Corrected v4 Table 11 (\texttt{P-H3-Image} \texttt{4.1 MP}):} \texttt{check\_c} (\texttt{s=1.0: 0.229 -> s=1.5: 0.041}) and \texttt{check\_b} ran \textbf{\texttt{v1d\_erase}} (not \texttt{mud\_erase}), alongside \texttt{6}-arm RMS-locked (\texttt{101.25}) double dissociation (\texttt{5/5} B\&W \& \texttt{5/5} character retention for \texttt{S1\_own\_Vr} vs. \texttt{0/5} on swapped/random/prompt-PC baselines) and undistilled \texttt{50}-step Base H3 generalization.
\end{itemize}

\subsection{Multi-Slider Equilibrium \& Conditioning-Norm Cliff Proof (\texttt{Stage 1 + Gate 4})}

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Refutation of v4's \texttt{"5+ Sliders"} Claim (Phase 4 Unprotected Stacks):} Even with clamped eigenvalues ($\lambda_{\max} \le 1.0$), omitting per-slider \texttt{ROS} and norm compression caused \texttt{box\_office s=730451892} \texttt{stack3} to exceed \texttt{Base} saturation (\texttt{0.3083 > 0.2920}, deleting the clerk at \texttt{161.11} peak shift) and drove \texttt{4.0 MP} \texttt{MiniMax-H3-Image} \texttt{lighthouse} (\texttt{claymation 1.20 + noir 1.15}, \texttt{net\_shift = 133.42}) into a vertical diptych (\texttt{clip = 0.07255}).
\item \textbf{Stage 1 + Gate 4 \& Gate 2A Multi-Bus Resolution (\texttt{dd45600e} + \texttt{340e8ded}):} Enabling \texttt{peer\_ros=True}, barrier-aware resolved-mask batching across non-consecutive masks (\texttt{h3\_spans.py::inference\_mask} collapse handling), and \texttt{soft\_cap\_stacked\_rms} (\texttt{95.5 -> 98.5}) \textbf{eliminated the tested \texttt{lighthouse} diptych} (\texttt{0} diptychs, \texttt{hsv\_sat = 0.1136}, \texttt{lap = 437.15}, \texttt{clip = 0.00790}, \texttt{3.07s}), halved \texttt{box\_office} \texttt{stack3} saturation (\texttt{0.3187 -> 0.1661}), and held \texttt{192f} Gate 2A multi-bus stacks (\texttt{blacklight\_uv\_rave 1.35 + reverb\_cathedral 1.25} on \texttt{kitchen}, \texttt{mercury\_liquid\_chrome 1.35 + zero\_gravity 1.35} on \texttt{stairwell}) visually intact on \texttt{shipped} weights.
\item \textbf{Bus-Scoped \texttt{V\_r} (\texttt{run\_stage3\_cpu\_prototypes.py} vs. Gate 2A GPU Rejection):} On CPU, \texttt{bus\_scoped\_audio\_motion\_drop\_look\_pc16} keeps \textbf{\texttt{1.0000}} Look Regime A clearing while cutting \texttt{look<->audio} Grassmann overlap \textbf{\texttt{7.94x}} (\texttt{0.1381 -> 0.0174}) and \texttt{look<->motion} \textbf{\texttt{6.66x}} (\texttt{0.1606 -> 0.0241}). However, live GPU Gate 2A A/B using non-destructive helpers (\texttt{control\_vectors.py::\{compute\_bus\_erasure\_basis, project\_erasure\_orthogonal\_to\_basis\}}) \textbf{rejected bank promotion}: stacking \texttt{blacklight\_uv\_rave 1.35 + reverb\_cathedral} (\texttt{1.25}) on \texttt{t2va\_restaurant\_kitchen.txt} (\texttt{192f}) remained crisp on \texttt{shipped} weights (\texttt{mid\_lap = 43.44}, \texttt{sat = 0.3917}, \texttt{rgb\_mae = 71.904}, \texttt{78.47s}), whereas \texttt{pc8} and \texttt{pc16} drove severe white-magenta overexposure bloom at \texttt{f96} (\texttt{mid\_lap = 7.95} and \texttt{17.38}, \texttt{pc16} shifting \texttt{YIN} $F_0$ \texttt{+3.377 st} vs. \texttt{+1.712 st} shipped), and \texttt{chrome + zero\_gravity} on \texttt{stairwell} required no projection (\texttt{shipped} \texttt{rgb\_mae = 64.228}, \texttt{YIN +0.099 st} vs. \texttt{pc8 +0.289 st}, \texttt{pc16 -0.297 st}). Saved \texttt{bank/} weights remain untouched.
\end{itemize}

\subsection{Honest Regime A vs. Regime B Case Study (\texttt{de\_llm\_slop} \& \texttt{b\_side\_alignment})}

Contrary to Paper v4's single-metric \texttt{de\_llm\_slop} citation (\texttt{box\_office} saturation \texttt{0.5964 -> 0.3615}), disk inspection reveals why Regime B one-sided nudges fail under symmetric subtraction: \texttt{de\_llm\_slop}'s \texttt{.safetensors} header shows raw \texttt{b\_side\_alignment.coverage = 0.071} (\texttt{1/14}, drifted toward \texttt{document/chronological/institutional}), \texttt{-0.25..-0.34} anti-correlation with \texttt{11} creative/audio stems, \texttt{-33\%..-39\%} Laplacian sharpness drops on clean scenes (\texttt{hardware\_aisle}, \texttt{freight\_elevator}, \texttt{clockmaker}), mixed-sign highlight clipping (\texttt{3.58x-6.83x} blow-up on \texttt{sitcom\_kitchen}, spikes from \texttt{< 0.25\%} denominators on \texttt{freight\_elevator s=730451892} and \texttt{clockmaker}, decreases on \texttt{freight\_elevator s=101} and \texttt{lighthouse}), and \texttt{-13.38 dB} (Phase 3) / \texttt{-2.45 dB} (Phase 4) audio attenuation. Separately, auditing \texttt{j\_lens.py::check\_b\_side\_alignment} showed raw \texttt{coverage >= 0.25} failed \texttt{44/52} (\texttt{84.6\%}) built stems purely from dividing top-\texttt{8} hits by \texttt{14-25+} unfiltered tokens, motivating \texttt{effective\_coverage} (\texttt{min(len(target\_words), max(8, len(pos\_words)))}) now landed in \texttt{48031b0e}.

\subsection{Track 2 Push-Side Falsification \& Dual-Lock Frontier (CPU vs. Unverified GPU Paths)}

Evaluating zero-external-corpus Track 2 push routers on CPU across all \texttt{7} \texttt{.pt} banks (\texttt{scripts/audit\_track2\_multivector\_pole\_b.py}, \texttt{scripts/run\_stage3\_cpu\_prototypes.py}) establishes:
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]
\item Prompt-centering keys (\texttt{a\_n - a\_bar\_p}) doubles/triples Track 2A LOPO MSE gains (\texttt{look\_direct\_1990s\_flash -14.34\%}, \texttt{noir -5.03\%}, \texttt{molten\_lava\_golem -3.79\%}) vs. uncentered keys.
\item \textbf{Honest Falsification of Implicit \texttt{Path 1B} Cosine Role Routing:} Zero-GPU \texttt{5}-role Loewdin keys (\texttt{camera}, \texttt{lighting}, \texttt{subject}, \texttt{environment}, \texttt{motion}) win \texttt{7/7} LOPO over overfitting fixed clusters yet achieve \texttt{< 1.1\%} MSE gain (\texttt{-0.09\%} to \texttt{-1.08\%}) because \texttt{TokenRefiner} self-attention bleeds stop-words at \texttt{0.21-0.29} cosine.
\item \textbf{GPU Falsification of \texttt{Path 1C} \texttt{ColQwen} \texttt{vision\_tokens} Dual-Lock (Gate 2B) \& Open \texttt{Path 1A}:} After wiring CLI \texttt{--scene-prompts} forwarding (\texttt{bench/control\_vector/make\_cmds.py}), soft-hold/\texttt{erasure.mu\_a} scrubbing (\texttt{bench/control\_vector/helpers.py::\_apply\_erasure\_holds}), and tag-0 \texttt{target="vision\_tokens"} routing (\texttt{control\_vector\_nodes.py}, \texttt{h3\_spans.py}), Gate 2B tested \texttt{noir\_colqwen\_p1c} (\texttt{N = 6} aligned \texttt{512x512} portrait pairs, \texttt{hold\_alpha = 0.65} on \texttt{face, eyes, nose, mouth, identity, portrait}, \texttt{erasure.vr [8, 5376]}, \texttt{erasure.mu\_a} norm \texttt{80.63}, \texttt{mu\_d} norm \texttt{16.53}, \texttt{pairwise\_cos = 0.507}, \texttt{split\_half = 0.754}) on \texttt{90f} \texttt{ref2va} (\texttt{prompt\_bank/ref2va\_woman\_blonde\_street.txt}, \texttt{woman\_blonde.jpg}, \texttt{MiniMaxH3ReleaseReferences(end\_percent=0.17, clean\_level=0.90/0.85)}): \texttt{vision\_tokens}-only held \texttt{hsv\_sat = 0.2432} vs. base \texttt{0.2477} (leaving green awning and warm hair/skin intact, \texttt{DINOv3 cos = 0.34639 color / 0.32364 gray}), and dual (\texttt{vision\_tokens 1.35 + noir 1.35 scene\_only}) stayed \texttt{0.2351} (\texttt{0.2225} at \texttt{clean\_level=0.85}, \texttt{p1c=1.5})---weaker than \texttt{noir scene\_only} alone at \texttt{rel100} (\texttt{0.1919}) or \texttt{rel17} (\texttt{0.2140}). Modifying tag-0 Qwen embeddings does not override the raw \texttt{<Picture 1>} \texttt{reference\_latent} VAE pixels in DiT self-attention; \texttt{noir\_colqwen\_p1c} remains unpromoted outside \texttt{bank/}, while explicit \textbf{\texttt{Path 1A}} Ward sub-fader sweeps remain untested on GPU.
\end{itemize}

\subsection{Diverse Adult \texttt{192f} Matrix, \texttt{345f} Sol Parity, \& \texttt{1x Q\_vid[mask]} vs. \texttt{2x} Gate (\texttt{Wave 2}, \texttt{MiniMaxH3Sol})}

Evaluating the \texttt{4} verified \texttt{t=1} winners across bright \texttt{prompt\_bank/t2va\_restaurant\_kitchen.txt} and dim \texttt{prompt\_bank/t2va\_stairwell\_dialogue.txt} (\texttt{1152x768}, \texttt{s = 1.35}, \texttt{seed = 730451892}, \texttt{bench/results/2026-11-23\_wave2\_gpu\_gates\_bus\_vr\_path1c\_and\_qvid.md}; excluding retired \texttt{paper\_origami}, \texttt{wes\_anderson\_symmetry}, \texttt{earthquake\_tremor}, \texttt{stained\_glass\_cathedral}, and child/teen scenes) establishes both strengths and scene-dependent boundaries:
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{\texttt{192f} \texttt{4}-Winner Scene Matrix (\texttt{72.27-77.97s}):} On \texttt{kitchen}, \texttt{charcoal\_sketch\_animated} converts full scene structure into monochrome charcoal illustration (\texttt{sat 0.3730 -> 0.1681}, \texttt{mid\_lap 157.49 -> 599.11}, \texttt{rgb\_mae = 77.298}, paired \texttt{YIN} $F_0 = +0.205\text{ st}$), \texttt{x\_ray\_fluoroscope} injects glowing cyan radiographic jaw/throat anatomy (\texttt{luma = 73.92}, \texttt{rgb\_mae = 64.362}), \texttt{mercury\_liquid\_chrome} adds warm golden metallic reflections (\texttt{sat = 0.3510}, \texttt{rgb\_mae = 68.452}), and \texttt{blacklight\_uv\_rave} drives intense blue-violet UV flame highlights (\texttt{rgb\_mae = 68.263}, \texttt{YIN +1.794 st} triage shift). On dim \texttt{stairwell}, \texttt{mercury\_liquid\_chrome} cleanly transforms jacket lapels (\texttt{rgb\_mae = 49.670}, paired \texttt{YIN +0.528 st}) and \texttt{blacklight\_uv\_rave} hits sharp cyan/magenta bounce (\texttt{rgb\_mae = 42.775}), whereas \texttt{charcoal\_sketch\_animated} stays partial (\texttt{rgb\_mae = 39.270}, \texttt{sat = 0.3459}, eye/cheek charcoal hatching) and \texttt{x\_ray\_fluoroscope} renders a partial lower-face skeletal overlay (\texttt{rgb\_mae = 52.262}).
\item \textbf{\texttt{192f} \texttt{1x} Stream/Band Isolation \& \texttt{345f} Long-Window \texttt{MiniMaxH3Sol} Check:} \texttt{charcoal\_192f\_vidonly\_1x} (\texttt{streams="video\_only"}) matched base latency (\texttt{76.55s} vs. \texttt{77.81s}) with near-zero paired \texttt{YIN} $F_0$ drift (\texttt{-0.039 st} vs. \texttt{both} \texttt{+0.763 st}); \texttt{reverb\_192f\_audonly\_late30} (\texttt{streams="audio\_only"}, \texttt{block\_band="late\_30\_49"}) shifted spectral centroid (\texttt{2505.2 -> 2687.3 Hz}, \texttt{rgb\_mae = 7.461}, \texttt{75.25s}). At \texttt{345f} under \texttt{MiniMaxH3Sol}, \texttt{charcoal\_stairwell\_345f} (\texttt{159.79s} vs. \texttt{base\_stairwell\_345f} \texttt{165.85s}) completed multi-shot generation (\texttt{rgb\_mae = 48.857}, \texttt{half2 = 60.183}, paired \texttt{YIN +0.007 st}) with zero graph crashes or seam breaks. Net-new physics behaviors (\texttt{sudden\_takeoff\_flight}, \texttt{youtube\_overhype\_influencer}) remain separate \texttt{Wave 3} benchmarks.
\item \textbf{Gate 2C Empirical Falsification of \texttt{1x Q\_vid[mask]} (\texttt{90f} \texttt{kitchen}, \texttt{charcoal 1.35}, \texttt{n\_vid = 23,328} tokens):} Compared against \texttt{2x MiniMaxH3Sol EditGuider} (\texttt{editguider\_2x\_temporal}: \texttt{49.28s}, \texttt{263.8 MB}, \texttt{breaks = 199}, \texttt{contrast = 1.475x}; \texttt{editguider\_2x\_portal}: \texttt{49.75s}, \texttt{264.2 MB}, \texttt{contrast = 1.421x} crisp localized charcoal inside a \texttt{24.5\%} moving portal), dense \texttt{1x Q\_vid[mask]} splicing (\texttt{300} splices, \texttt{breaks = 99}) failed both sub-gates (\texttt{verdict = "FAIL"}): spatial portals collapsed to \texttt{1.090x / 1.052x / 1.047x} inside/outside contrast at \texttt{alpha = 1.0 / 1.3 / 1.5} (\texttt{35.27-36.17s}, \texttt{395.8-963.8 MB}) as bidirectional \texttt{K\_vid, V\_vid} attention washed out masks and drifted layout into an empty stove, while \texttt{51.9\%} temporal halves reached \texttt{1.342x / 1.381x / 1.335x} at only \texttt{1.11x / 1.08x / 1.07x} speed (\texttt{44.25-46.22s}, \texttt{570.0-1836.1 MB}, visual smudge/blank-counter artifacts at \texttt{alpha = 1.5}). \texttt{Split-Text Online-Softmax Merge} is not promoted.
\end{itemize}


\section{Systems Boundaries \& Limitations}

\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Hardware Execution Boundaries:} \texttt{FrozenVideoCache} skips \texttt{double\_block} hooks and requires explicit \texttt{Mode 0} separation (\texttt{control\_vector\_nodes.py::MiniMaxH3Steer}). Gate 2C (\texttt{90f} \texttt{MiniMaxH3Sol}, \texttt{charcoal 1.35}) empirically settled why \texttt{1x} query slicing remains confined to \texttt{130-810} stereo \texttt{Q\_aud} rows (\texttt{2 * audio\_t}: \texttt{130} at \texttt{39f}, \texttt{300} at \texttt{90f}, \texttt{640} at \texttt{192f}, \texttt{810} at \texttt{243f}; \texttt{1x Q\_aud -> K\_txt\_base}): \texttt{1x Q\_vid[mask]} failed both \texttt{24.5\%} portal (\texttt{1.047x-1.090x} contrast with \texttt{K\_vid, V\_vid} washout and layout drift vs. \texttt{1.421x} \texttt{2x EditGuider}) and \texttt{51.9\%} temporal (\texttt{1.335x-1.381x} at \texttt{1.07x-1.11x} speed and \texttt{1836.1 MB} peak VRAM vs. \texttt{263.8 MB} \texttt{2x}), leaving \texttt{Split-Text Online-Softmax Merge} unpromoted.
\item \textbf{Modality / Tool Frontier:} \texttt{1x} Multi-Vector Prelude Steering targets styles, materials, weather, kinematics, and \texttt{40 Hz} acoustics; \texttt{2x} \texttt{MiniMaxH3EditGuider} retains novel multi-entity attribute binding, rigid-body event invention, and \texttt{< 30\%} spatial portals; \texttt{1x} \texttt{MiniMaxH3PromptExpander} owns multi-shot scripting and upstream prose cleanup.
\item \textbf{Single-Architecture Scope:} All measurements, causal depth traces, and multi-slider failure/recovery bounds in this work evaluate exclusively four MiniMax H3 checkpoints (\texttt{Qwen3-VL-32B} + \texttt{2}-block bidirectional \texttt{TokenRefiner} + \texttt{50}-block joint AV DiT). Generalization to external DiT families (\texttt{Qwen-Image-2.1}, explicitly deferred) or recurrent/masked-diffusion architectures is untested and out of scope.
\end{enumerate}
